title: Sourdough bakery
heading: Sourdough
Bakery
summary: A bakery that opens at six, and a sign you can read from the end of the street.

body.p: The bakery bakes one bread and does it well. The identity is just as plain: one colour, one typeface, one stamp.
We started with the sign over the door and worked inward, to the bags, the till receipts and a [contact page](/contact) that says when the bread runs out.
